subject: DI04005071

intro_text.en: Unit 5: petrochemicals — what they are, how they are classified, where their feedstocks come from, and the syllabus building-block processes: methanol and formaldehyde from C1, vinyl chloride and ethylene oxide from C2, propylene oxide from C3, and linear alkyl benzene from the aromatics. The stoichiometric-yield derivation and its numericals follow the locked style.
intro_text.gu: Unit 5: petrochemicals — તે શું છે, તેમનું classification કેવી રીતે થાય છે, તેમના feedstocks ક્યાંથી આવે છે, અને syllabus ના building-block processes: C1 માંથી methanol તથા formaldehyde, C2 માંથી vinyl chloride તથા ethylene oxide, C3 માંથી propylene oxide, અને aromatics માંથી linear alkyl benzene. Stoichiometric-yield derivation તથા તેના numericals locked style મુજબ છે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Petrochemicals are chemicals manufactured from petroleum and natural-gas feedstocks — hydrocarbons (and hydrogen/syngas made from them) converted by chemical processing into the building blocks and products of the modern chemical industry.

Classification / representative type

FamilyBuilding blocks from the refinery/gas plantTypical end products
C1 (methane/syngas)Methanol from CO + H2; formaldehyde from methanolResins, adhesives, solvents, acetic acid
C2 (ethylene family)Ethylene from steam cracking; vinyl chloride, ethylene oxide from ethylenePVC, polyethylene, glycols, detergents auxiliaries
C3 (propylene family)Propylene from FCC/steam cracking; propylene oxidePolypropylene, polyurethanes (via PO), acrylonitrile
Aromatics (BTX)Benzene, toluene, xylenes from reformate/steam-cracker liquids; LAB from benzeneDetergents (LAB), styrene, nylon intermediates, polyester

Key points and data

  • Two levels: first-generation building blocks (olefins, aromatics, methanol) are converted to intermediate chemicals and then to polymers and consumer products.
  • Scale character: petrochemical plants run very large and continuous; a small yield change moves more material than a whole specialty-chemical plant makes.

Qualification

'Petrochemical' names the origin of the carbon, not the product: methanol or benzene from petroleum is chemically identical to the same product from any other feedstock, which is why feedstock price, not product quality, dominates petrochemical economics.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

Petrochemicals એ petroleum તથા natural-gas feedstocks માંથી બનતા chemicals છે — hydrocarbons (અને તેમનામાંથી બનતા hydrogen/syngas) જે chemical processing થી આધુનિક chemical industry ના building blocks તથા products માં ફેરવાય છે.

Classification / representative type

કુટુંબRefinery/gas plant માંથી building blocksTypical end products
C1 (methane/syngas)CO + H2 માંથી methanol; methanol માંથી formaldehydeResins, adhesives, solvents, acetic acid
C2 (ethylene family)Steam cracking માંથી ethylene; ethylene માંથી vinyl chloride, ethylene oxidePVC, polyethylene, glycols, detergent auxiliaries
C3 (propylene family)FCC/steam cracking માંથી propylene; propylene oxidePolypropylene, polyurethanes (PO મારફતે), acrylonitrile
Aromatics (BTX)Reformate/steam-cracker liquids માંથી benzene, toluene, xylenes; benzene માંથી LABDetergents (LAB), styrene, nylon intermediates, polyester

મુખ્ય મુદ્દા તથા data

  • બે levels: first-generation building blocks (olefins, aromatics, methanol) intermediate chemicals માં અને પછી polymers તથા consumer products માં ફેરવાય છે.
  • Scale character: petrochemical plants ખૂબ મોટા તથા continuous ચાલે છે; નાનો yield ફેરફાર પણ આખા specialty-chemical plant ના ઉત્પાદન કરતાં વધુ material ખસેડે છે.

મર્યાદા / Qualification

'Petrochemical' carbon ના મૂળને નામ આપે છે, product ને નહીં: petroleum માંથી methanol કે benzene બીજા કોઈ feedstock માંથી મળતા એ જ product થી રાસાયણિક રીતે સમાન છે, તેથી જ feedstock કિંમત, product quality નહીં, petrochemical economics પર પ્રભુત્વ ધરાવે છે.

h.en: 5.1(b) Petrochemical feedstocks — where the building blocks come from
h.gu: 5.1(b) Petrochemical feedstocks — building blocks ક્યાંથી આવે છે

body.en:
Definition / principle

A petrochemical feedstock is any refinery or gas-plant stream whose hydrocarbons are chemically converted rather than burned as fuel: natural gas and LPG, naphtha, gas oils, and refinery off-gases.

Detailed theory and conditions

Feedstock choice decides the whole slate. Natural gas gives syngas for the C1 chain (methanol and its derivatives). Naphtha and LPG are steam-cracked to ethylene, propylene and butadiene, with pyrolysis gasoline rich in aromatics; ethane-rich gas gives mainly ethylene. Catalytic reformate (Unit III) is the principal source of benzene, toluene and xylenes, supplemented by those pyrolysis liquids. FCC (Unit III) supplies propylene and butylenes directly. Because every feedstock also has a fuel value, petrochemical manufacture is always an economic allocation: the same naphtha molecule can become petrol blendstock, reformer feed for aromatics, or cracker feed for olefins, and refineries integrated with petrochemical plants move streams between fuels and chemicals as prices change.

Key points and data

  • Gas-based route: methane → syngas → methanol chain; ethane → ethylene.
  • Liquid-based route: naphtha steam cracking → olefins + aromatics; reforming → BTX.
  • Refinery-gas route: FCC propylene/butylenes, reformer hydrogen — coproducts of fuel making.

Qualification

No feedstock is 'waste' to a petrochemical plant by default: each has an opportunity cost as fuel, so 'petrochemicals from refinery streams' means deliberately diverting valuable streams, not using rubbish.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

Petrochemical feedstock એ કોઈપણ refinery કે gas-plant stream છે જેના hydrocarbons fuel તરીકે બાળવાને બદલે રાસાયણિક રીતે ફેરવાય છે: natural gas તથા LPG, naphtha, gas oils, અને refinery off-gases.

વિગતવાર Theory તથા Conditions

Feedstock પસંદગી આખો slate નક્કી કરે છે. Natural gas C1 chain (methanol તથા તેના derivatives) માટે syngas આપે છે. Naphtha તથા LPG ethylene, propylene તથા butadiene માટે steam-crack થાય છે, aromatics થી સમૃદ્ધ pyrolysis gasoline સાથે; ethane-rich gas મુખ્યત્વે ethylene આપે છે. Catalytic reformate (Unit III) benzene, toluene તથા xylenes નો મુખ્ય સ્રોત છે, તે pyrolysis liquids થી પૂરક મળે છે. FCC (Unit III) propylene તથા butylenes સીધા પૂરા પાડે છે. દરેક feedstock નું fuel value પણ હોવાથી, petrochemical manufacture હંમેશા economic allocation છે: એ જ naphtha molecule petrol blendstock, aromatics માટે reformer feed, કે olefins માટે cracker feed બની શકે છે, અને petrochemical plants સાથે integrated refineries ભાવ બદલાતાં fuels તથા chemicals વચ્ચે streams ખસેડે છે.

મુખ્ય મુદ્દા તથા data

  • Gas-based route: methane → syngas → methanol chain; ethane → ethylene.
  • Liquid-based route: naphtha steam cracking → olefins + aromatics; reforming → BTX.
  • Refinery-gas route: FCC propylene/butylenes, reformer hydrogen — fuel બનાવવાના coproducts.

મર્યાદા / Qualification

કોઈ feedstock petrochemical plant માટે મૂળભૂત રીતે 'waste' નથી: દરેકની fuel તરીકે opportunity cost છે, તેથી 'refinery streams માંથી petrochemicals' નો અર્થ મૂલ્યવાન streams ને જાણીજોઈને divert કરવા થાય છે, કચરો વાપરવા નહીં.

h.en: Derivation: theoretical (stoichiometric) yield of a petrochemical reaction
h.gu: Derivation: petrochemical reaction નો theoretical (stoichiometric) yield

body.en:
Symbols, model and assumptions

One reaction with a stated limiting reactant; extent limited only by the balanced equation (theoretical ceiling). Feed A of mass mA and molar mass MA; product P with coefficients νA, νP and molar mass MP. Real yield then applies the plant's fractional yield η to this ceiling.

  1. Convert the limiting-reactant mass to moles.

    nA = mA / MA

  2. Use the mole ratio of the balanced equation to get product moles.

    nP = nA × (νP / νA)

  3. Convert product moles back to mass — the theoretical yield.

    mP(theoretical) = nP × MP

  4. Combine the three steps into one line and then apply actual yield.

    mP(theoretical) = mA × (νP·MP) / (νA·MA)
    mP(actual) = mP(theoretical) × η

4-mark / 7-mark study depth

4-mark path: moles in → mole ratio → boxed theoretical yield → apply η. For a full 7-mark format state the limiting reactant and why (which reactant runs out first at the given feed ratio), and check that atoms balance. These are study formats, not guaranteed official question marks. Numericals 5.N1 to 5.N3 use this result.
body.gu:
સંકેતો, Model તથા Assumptions

જણાવેલ limiting reactant સાથે એક reaction; extent ફક્ત balanced equation થી મર્યાદિત (theoretical ceiling). Feed A mass mA તથા molar mass MA સાથે; product P coefficients νA, νP તથા molar mass MP સાથે. Real yield પછી plant ના fractional yield η ને આ ceiling પર લાગુ કરે છે.

  1. Limiting-reactant mass ને moles માં ફેરવો.

    nA = mA / MA

  2. Balanced equation ના mole ratio થી product moles મેળવો.

    nP = nA × (νP / νA)

  3. Product moles ને mass માં પાછા ફેરવો — theoretical yield.

    mP(theoretical) = nP × MP

  4. ત્રણ steps ને એક line માં જોડો અને પછી actual yield લાગુ કરો.

    mP(theoretical) = mA × (νP·MP) / (νA·MA)
    mP(actual) = mP(theoretical) × η

4-mark / 7-mark Study Depth

4-mark path: moles in → mole ratio → boxed theoretical yield → η લાગુ કરો. Full 7-mark format માટે limiting reactant તથા તેનું કારણ જણાવો (આપેલા feed ratio પર કયો reactant પહેલાં ખૂટે છે), અને atoms balance થાય છે તે check કરો. આ study formats છે; official marks ની ખાતરી નથી. Numericals 5.N1 થી 5.N3 આ result વાપરે છે.

h.en: 5.2(a) Manufacture of methanol from synthesis gas
h.gu: 5.2(a) Synthesis gas માંથી methanol નું manufacture

body.en:
Definition / principle

Methanol (CH3OH) is made by the catalytic hydrogenation of carbon monoxide in synthesis gas (from natural-gas reforming) over a copper-based catalyst, in a recycle loop.

CO + 2 H2 ⇌ CH3OH (heat released)

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Syngas preparation: natural gas is steam-reformed/desulfurised to a CO/H2 mixture with composition adjusted for the synthesis (CO2 also participates over the modern Cu/ZnO/Al2O3 catalyst).
  2. Converter (reactor): gas passes over the catalyst at moderate temperature and elevated pressure (modern low-pressure process, of the order of 220–280 °C and 50–100 bar — licensor-dependent); only part converts per pass because the reaction is equilibrium-limited.
  3. Condenser, separator and recycle: methanol (and water) condense out; unconverted gas is recompressed and recycled, with a small purge to reject inerts.
  4. Distillation: crude methanol is purified of water and light ends to grade.

Working — sequence and reason

Low temperature favours the equilibrium (heat is released) but slows the catalyst; the chosen temperature is the compromise, and the recycle recovers what equilibrium leaves unconverted in one pass — Numerical 5.N1 works the stoichiometry of this synthesis.

Limitations and safety

Methanol is toxic and flammable, syngas contains toxic CO, and sulfur poisons the copper catalyst (feed desulfurisation is essential): the plant is a closed, high-pressure system under chemical-plant procedures, described here at syllabus level only.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

Methanol (CH3OH) synthesis gas (natural-gas reforming માંથી) માં carbon monoxide ના copper-based catalyst પર recycle loop માં catalytic hydrogenation થી બને છે.

CO + 2 H2 ⇌ CH3OH (heat છૂટે છે)

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Syngas preparation: natural gas steam-reform/desulfurise થઈ synthesis માટે composition adjusted CO/H2 mixture બને છે (આધુનિક Cu/ZnO/Al2O3 catalyst પર CO2 પણ ભાગ લે છે).
  2. Converter (reactor): gas catalyst પર moderate temperature તથા elevated pressure પર પસાર થાય છે (આધુનિક low-pressure process, આશરે 220–280 °C તથા 50–100 bar ક્રમનું — licensor-આધારિત); reaction equilibrium-limited હોવાથી pass દીઠ ભાગ જ convert થાય છે.
  3. Condenser, separator તથા recycle: methanol (અને water) condense થઈ બહાર આવે છે; unconverted gas recompress થઈ recycle થાય છે, inerts નકારવા નાના purge સાથે.
  4. Distillation: crude methanol water તથા light ends થી શુદ્ધ થઈ grade પર આવે છે.

Working — sequence and reason

નીચું temperature equilibrium ને પ્રાધાન્ય આપે છે (heat છૂટે છે) પણ catalyst ને ધીમો કરે છે; પસંદ કરેલ temperature સમાધાન છે, અને recycle એક pass માં equilibrium જે unconverted છોડે છે તે recover કરે છે — Numerical 5.N1 આ synthesis ની stoichiometry ગણે છે.

મર્યાદાઓ તથા safety

Methanol toxic તથા flammable છે, syngas માં toxic CO હોય છે, અને sulfur copper catalyst ને poison કરે છે (feed desulfurisation અનિવાર્ય છે): plant chemical-plant procedures હેઠળ closed, high-pressure system છે, અહીં ફક્ત syllabus level પર વર્ણવ્યું છે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Formaldehyde (HCHO, used as aqueous 'formalin') is made by oxidising methanol vapour with air over a catalyst — either a silver catalyst (with dehydrogenation) or an iron–molybdenum oxide catalyst (excess-air oxidation).

Silver route (overall): CH3OH + ½ O2 → HCHO + H2O
Oxide route: CH3OH + ½ O2 → HCHO + H2O (excess air, lower temperature)

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Vaporiser/mixer: methanol vapour is mixed with a controlled air ratio (composition kept outside the explosive range by the process design).
  2. Reactor: the mixture passes over the catalyst (silver at high temperature, of the order of 600 °C, or Fe-Mo oxide at roughly 300–400 °C, typical ranges); reaction heat is recovered as steam.
  3. Absorber: formaldehyde is absorbed in water to give formalin solution of saleable strength; tail gas is safely disposed of by plant systems.

Working — sequence and reason

The catalyst surface removes hydrogen from methanol and oxygen completes it to water; stopping at formaldehyde instead of burning to CO2 is the selectivity problem of the process, and absorption must be fast because formaldehyde polymerises and reacts in the gas phase if mishandled. Numerical 5.N2 applies the Unit 5 stoichiometry to this conversion.

Limitations and safety

Formaldehyde is toxic and a sensitiser, methanol–air mixtures are explosive outside controlled composition, and formalin handling needs closed systems: plant procedures and occupational-health controls govern all operations.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

Formaldehyde (HCHO, aqueous 'formalin' તરીકે વપરાય છે) methanol vapour ને catalyst પર air સાથે oxidise કરી બને છે — કાં તો silver catalyst (dehydrogenation સાથે) કે iron–molybdenum oxide catalyst (excess-air oxidation).

Silver route (overall): CH3OH + ½ O2 → HCHO + H2O
Oxide route: CH3OH + ½ O2 → HCHO + H2O (excess air, નીચું temperature)

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Vaporiser/mixer: methanol vapour નિયંત્રિત air ratio સાથે ભળે છે (process design થી composition explosive range ની બહાર રાખવામાં આવે છે).
  2. Reactor: mixture catalyst પર પસાર થાય છે (silver ઊંચા temperature પર, આશરે 600 °C ક્રમનું, કે Fe-Mo oxide આશરે 300–400 °C પર, typical ranges); reaction heat steam તરીકે recover થાય છે.
  3. Absorber: formaldehyde water માં શોષાઈ વેચી શકાય તેવી strength નું formalin solution આપે છે; tail gas plant systems દ્વારા સુરક્ષિત રીતે નિકાલ થાય છે.

Working — sequence and reason

Catalyst surface methanol માંથી hydrogen દૂર કરે છે અને oxygen તેને water માં પૂર્ણ કરે છે; CO2 સુધી બાળવાને બદલે formaldehyde પર અટકવું એ process ની selectivity સમસ્યા છે, અને absorption ઝડપી હોવું જોઈએ કારણ કે ખોટી રીતે handle થતાં formaldehyde gas phase માં polymerise તથા react થાય છે. Numerical 5.N2 Unit 5 stoichiometry ને આ conversion પર લાગુ કરે છે.

મર્યાદાઓ તથા safety

Formaldehyde toxic તથા sensitiser છે, methanol–air mixtures નિયંત્રિત composition ની બહાર explosive છે, અને formalin handling ને closed systems જોઈએ છે: plant procedures તથા occupational-health controls તમામ operations નું સંચાલન કરે છે.

h.en: 5.3(a) Manufacture of vinyl chloride from ethylene (balanced process)
h.gu: 5.3(a) Ethylene માંથી vinyl chloride નું manufacture (balanced process)

body.en:
Definition / principle

Vinyl chloride monomer (VCM), CH2=CHCl, the monomer for PVC, is made from ethylene by the balanced process: half the ethylene is chlorinated, half is oxychlorinated with the HCl by-product, so no HCl is wasted.

Direct chlorination: CH2=CH2 + Cl2 → ClCH2–CH2Cl (EDC)
Oxychlorination: CH2=CH2 + 2 HCl + ½ O2 → EDC + H2O
EDC cracking: ClCH2–CH2Cl → CH2=CHCl + HCl

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Direct chlorination reactor: ethylene and chlorine form ethylene dichloride (EDC) in liquid EDC over a catalyst.
  2. Oxychlorination reactor: ethylene, recycled HCl and air/oxygen over copper chloride catalyst form more EDC and water.
  3. EDC purification and cracking furnace: purified EDC is thermally cracked to VCM plus HCl; the HCl returns to oxychlorination (the 'balance'), and uncracked EDC is recycled after separation from VCM.

Working — sequence and reason

Each cracking of two EDC gives two VCM and two HCl; those two HCl exactly chlorinate one further ethylene in oxychlorination, while the other ethylene came through direct chlorination — that is the atom balance worked in Numerical 5.N3, and the reason the modern process needs chlorine for only half its feed.

Limitations and safety

VCM is a known human carcinogen and chlorine/HCl are highly corrosive and toxic: the entire chain is closed, monitored and regulated, and is described here only at syllabus block-flow level.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

Vinyl chloride monomer (VCM), CH2=CHCl, PVC માટેનો monomer, ethylene માંથી balanced process દ્વારા બને છે: અડધું ethylene chlorinate થાય છે, અડધું HCl by-product સાથે oxychlorinate થાય છે, જેથી કોઈ HCl બગડતું નથી.

Direct chlorination: CH2=CH2 + Cl2 → ClCH2–CH2Cl (EDC)
Oxychlorination: CH2=CH2 + 2 HCl + ½ O2 → EDC + H2O
EDC cracking: ClCH2–CH2Cl → CH2=CHCl + HCl

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Direct chlorination reactor: ethylene તથા chlorine catalyst પર liquid EDC માં ethylene dichloride (EDC) બનાવે છે.
  2. Oxychlorination reactor: ethylene, recycled HCl તથા air/oxygen copper chloride catalyst પર વધુ EDC તથા water બનાવે છે.
  3. EDC purification તથા cracking furnace: શુદ્ધ EDC thermally crack થઈ VCM વત્તા HCl આપે છે; HCl oxychlorination તરફ પાછું જાય છે ('balance'), અને uncracked EDC VCM થી છૂટું પાડી recycle થાય છે.

Working — sequence and reason

બે EDC ના દરેક cracking થી બે VCM તથા બે HCl મળે છે; તે બે HCl બરાબર એક વધુ ethylene ને oxychlorination માં chlorinate કરે છે, જ્યારે બીજું ethylene direct chlorination માંથી આવ્યું હતું — તે જ atom balance Numerical 5.N3 માં ગણ્યું છે, અને આધુનિક process ને તેના feed ના અડધા માટે જ chlorine જોઈતું હોવાનું કારણ.

મર્યાદાઓ તથા safety

VCM જાણીતું human carcinogen છે અને chlorine/HCl અત્યંત corrosive તથા toxic છે: આખી chain closed, monitored તથા regulated છે, અને અહીં ફક્ત syllabus block-flow level પર વર્ણવી છે.

h.en: 5.3(b) Manufacture of ethylene oxide from ethylene
h.gu: 5.3(b) Ethylene માંથી ethylene oxide નું manufacture

body.en:
Definition / principle

Ethylene oxide (EO) is made by the direct catalytic oxidation of ethylene with oxygen over a silver catalyst — one of the few industrial oxidations that stops at the epoxide instead of burning to CO2.

Wanted: CH2=CH2 + ½ O2 → ethylene oxide (C2H4O)
Loss: CH2=CH2 + 3 O2 → 2 CO2 + 2 H2O

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Reactor: ethylene, oxygen (or air), ballast gas and trace inhibitor pass over silver catalyst in tubes cooled by a heat-transfer fluid (of the order of 200–300 °C, process-dependent); per-pass conversion is kept limited to protect selectivity.
  2. Absorber: EO is scrubbed out of the reactor gas with water; unconverted ethylene recycles to the reactor.
  3. Purification: EO is stripped and distilled from its aqueous solution; part is hydrolysed onward to ethylene glycol where that product is wanted.

Working — sequence and reason

Selectivity is everything: silver catalyses epoxidation, while total oxidation to CO2 wastes ethylene and adds heat. Small amounts of chlorinated inhibitor moderate the catalyst, and gas composition is kept outside flammable limits by design.

Limitations and safety

EO is toxic, carcinogenic and forms explosive mixtures over an exceptionally wide range; it is handled only in closed, instrumented plants. This card gives the syllabus flow, not operating instructions.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

Ethylene oxide (EO) ethylene ને silver catalyst પર oxygen સાથે direct catalytic oxidation કરી બને છે — CO2 સુધી બાળવાને બદલે epoxide પર અટકતા થોડા industrial oxidations માંનો એક.

ઇચ્છિત: CH2=CH2 + ½ O2 → ethylene oxide (C2H4O)
નુકસાન: CH2=CH2 + 3 O2 → 2 CO2 + 2 H2O

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Reactor: ethylene, oxygen (કે air), ballast gas તથા trace inhibitor heat-transfer fluid થી ઠંડી થતી tubes માં silver catalyst પર પસાર થાય છે (આશરે 200–300 °C ક્રમનું, process-આધારિત); selectivity બચાવવા per-pass conversion મર્યાદિત રાખવામાં આવે છે.
  2. Absorber: EO reactor gas માંથી water થી scrub થઈ બહાર આવે છે; unconverted ethylene reactor તરફ recycle થાય છે.
  3. Purification: EO તેના aqueous solution માંથી strip તથા distil થાય છે; ભાગ જ્યાં તે product જોઈએ ત્યાં ethylene glycol માં આગળ hydrolyse થાય છે.

Working — sequence and reason

Selectivity જ સર્વસ્વ છે: silver epoxidation ને catalyse કરે છે, જ્યારે CO2 સુધી total oxidation ethylene બગાડે છે અને heat ઉમેરે છે. Chlorinated inhibitor ની નાની માત્રા catalyst ને moderate કરે છે, અને gas composition design દ્વારા flammable limits ની બહાર રાખવામાં આવે છે.

મર્યાદાઓ તથા safety

EO toxic, carcinogenic છે અને અસાધારણ વિશાળ range પર explosive mixtures બનાવે છે; તે ફક્ત closed, instrumented plants માં handle થાય છે. આ card syllabus flow આપે છે, operating instructions નહીં.

h.en: 5.3(c) Manufacture of propylene oxide from propylene
h.gu: 5.3(c) Propylene માંથી propylene oxide નું manufacture

body.en:
Definition / principle

Propylene oxide (PO), the C3 epoxide used mainly for polyether polyols (polyurethanes) and propylene glycol, is manufactured from propylene by routes that carry an oxygen atom onto the double bond.

Classification / representative type

RouteOxidising system (concept)Co-product / character
Chlorohydrin process (classic)Propylene + chlorine/water to chlorohydrin, then lime/alkali closes the ringLarge salt/calcium chloride effluent; oldest route, declining
Hydroperoxide processes (PO/SM, PO/TBA)An organic hydroperoxide (from ethylbenzene or isobutane) transfers oxygen to propylene over a catalystValuable co-product (styrene or tert-butanol) — economics depend on selling it
HPPO process (modern)Hydrogen peroxide oxidises propylene over a titanium-silicalite catalystWater as the main by-product; cleanest route

Working — sequence and reason (common idea)

All routes do the same chemical job — deliver one oxygen atom across propylene's double bond to make the three-membered epoxide ring — and differ in what carries the oxygen and what by-product must be sold or disposed of; that co-product question, not the epoxidation itself, has decided which route a plant chooses.

Limitations and safety

PO is flammable and toxic; chlorohydrin effluent and peroxide handling are major plant-safety and environmental topics governed by chemical-plant procedures. Syllabus level: route recognition and comparison.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

Propylene oxide (PO), મુખ્યત્વે polyether polyols (polyurethanes) તથા propylene glycol માટે વપરાતું C3 epoxide, propylene માંથી double bond પર oxygen atom ચઢાવતા routes દ્વારા બને છે.

Classification / representative type

RouteOxidising system (concept)Co-product / character
Chlorohydrin process (classic)Propylene + chlorine/water થી chlorohydrin, પછી lime/alkali ring બંધ કરે છેમોટું salt/calcium chloride effluent; સૌથી જૂનો route, ઘટતો
Hydroperoxide processes (PO/SM, PO/TBA)Organic hydroperoxide (ethylbenzene કે isobutane માંથી) catalyst પર propylene ને oxygen transfer કરે છેમૂલ્યવાન co-product (styrene કે tert-butanol) — economics તેને વેચવા પર આધારિત
HPPO process (આધુનિક)Hydrogen peroxide titanium-silicalite catalyst પર propylene ને oxidise કરે છેWater મુખ્ય by-product તરીકે; સૌથી સ્વચ્છ route

Working — sequence and reason (સામાન્ય વિચાર)

બધા routes એ જ રાસાયણિક કામ કરે છે — propylene ના double bond પર એક oxygen atom પહોંચાડી three-membered epoxide ring બનાવવી — અને oxygen શું વહન કરે છે તથા કયો by-product વેચવો કે નિકાલ કરવો પડે છે તેમાં જુદા પડે છે; તે co-product પ્રશ્ન, epoxidation પોતે નહીં, એ નક્કી કરે છે કે plant કયો route પસંદ કરે છે.

મર્યાદાઓ તથા safety

PO flammable તથા toxic છે; chlorohydrin effluent તથા peroxide handling chemical-plant procedures દ્વારા સંચાલિત મુખ્ય plant-safety તથા environmental વિષયો છે. Syllabus level: route ઓળખ તથા comparison.

h.en: 5.4 Manufacture of linear alkyl benzene (LAB) from benzene and long-chain olefins
h.gu: 5.4 Benzene તથા long-chain olefins માંથી linear alkyl benzene (LAB) નું manufacture

body.en:
Definition / principle

Linear alkyl benzene (LAB) is benzene alkylated with a straight-chain C10–C14 olefin (or paraffin, dehydrogenated first); sulfonated LAB is the workhorse surfactant of synthetic detergents, 'linear' because straight chains biodegrade far better than the old branched alkylates.

Alkylation (concept): C6H6 + CnH2n (linear olefin) → C6H5–CnH2n+1 (LAB)

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Feed preparation: kerosene-range normal paraffins are separated (molecular-sieve extraction) and, in paraffin-based plants, dehydrogenated to linear olefins.
  2. Alkylation reactor: benzene (in excess) reacts with the olefin over an acid catalyst (historically HF or AlCl3; modern solid-acid Detal-type catalysts avoid liquid-acid handling).
  3. Separation train: unreacted benzene and paraffin are distilled off and recycled; LAB is purified from heavier dialkylates and sent to sulfonation (outside this unit's scope).

Working — sequence and reason

Excess benzene keeps the olefin dilute so that one benzene ring takes one chain (mono-alkylation) instead of forming heavy di- and poly-alkylates; chain length C10–C14 is chosen because it gives the detergency and solubility that detergent formulation needs.

Limitations and safety

Classic HF alkylation demands extreme corrosion/toxicity controls (the reason solid-acid catalysts displaced it); LAB itself must be sulfonated before use, and its biodegradation advantage holds only for the linear product, so branched contamination is controlled.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

Linear alkyl benzene (LAB) એ straight-chain C10–C14 olefin (કે paraffin, પહેલાં dehydrogenated) સાથે alkylate થયેલું benzene છે; sulfonated LAB synthetic detergents નો મુખ્ય surfactant છે, 'linear' એટલા માટે કે straight chains જૂના branched alkylates કરતાં ઘણી સારી રીતે biodegrade થાય છે.

Alkylation (concept): C6H6 + CnH2n (linear olefin) → C6H5–CnH2n+1 (LAB)

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Feed preparation: kerosene-range normal paraffins છૂટા પડે છે (molecular-sieve extraction) અને, paraffin-based plants માં, linear olefins માં dehydrogenate થાય છે.
  2. Alkylation reactor: benzene (વધુ માત્રામાં) olefin સાથે acid catalyst પર react થાય છે (ઐતિહાસિક રીતે HF કે AlCl3; આધુનિક solid-acid Detal-type catalysts liquid-acid handling ટાળે છે).
  3. Separation train: unreacted benzene તથા paraffin distil થઈ recycle થાય છે; LAB ભારે dialkylates થી શુદ્ધ થઈ sulfonation તરફ જાય છે (આ unit ના scope બહાર).

Working — sequence and reason

વધુ benzene olefin ને dilute રાખે છે જેથી એક benzene ring ભારે di- તથા poly-alkylates બનાવવાને બદલે એક chain લે (mono-alkylation); chain length C10–C14 એટલા માટે પસંદ થાય છે કે તે detergent formulation ને જોઈતી detergency તથા solubility આપે છે.

મર્યાદાઓ તથા safety

Classic HF alkylation અત્યંત corrosion/toxicity controls માંગે છે (solid-acid catalysts એ તેને હટાવ્યું તેનું કારણ); LAB ને વાપરતાં પહેલાં sulfonate કરવું જ પડે છે, અને તેનો biodegradation ફાયદો ફક્ત linear product માટે જ ટકે છે, તેથી branched contamination નિયંત્રિત થાય છે.

h.en: Practical.2/Activity: Prepare charts of petrochemical feedstocks and any one building-block process (guided)
h.gu: Practical.2/Activity: Petrochemical feedstocks તથા કોઈ એક building-block process ના charts બનાવો (guided)

body.en:
Aim and apparatus

Aim: to chart (i) petrochemical feedstocks from refinery/gas streams and (ii) one process from this unit (methanol, formaldehyde, VCM, EO, PO or LAB) at block-flow level. Materials: unit cards and diagrams, chart sheets.

Qualified-supervised procedure

  1. Draw the feedstock tree: gas, naphtha/LPG and reformate/FCC streams to their building blocks (diagram ref5_feedstocks pattern).
  2. For the chosen process, show feed preparation, reactor, separation/recycle and product, with the Unit 5 reaction written above the reactor block.
  3. Mark every recycle (unconverted feed, HCl in VCM, benzene in LAB) and state in one line why it exists.

Precautions

Charts must not invent operating data: conditions are quoted only as the typical ranges the cards state, and no plant visit or plant data is claimed unless the institute arranged and recorded it separately.

Observations and result

Journal record: feedstock tree complete ___, process charted ___, recycles identified ___, reaction shown ___. Chart activity only.

h.en: Practice 1. Define petrochemicals and classify them with one building block and one end product for each family.
h.gu: Practice 1. Petrochemicals ની વ્યાખ્યા આપો અને દરેક family માટે એક building block તથા એક end product સાથે classification કરો.

body.en:
Definition

Petrochemicals are chemicals made by converting petroleum/natural-gas hydrocarbons.

Explanation and application

  • C1 methanol → formaldehyde/resins; C2 ethylene → VCM (PVC), EO (glycols).
  • C3 propylene → propylene oxide (polyurethanes); aromatics benzene → LAB (detergents).
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Petrochemicals એ petroleum/natural-gas hydrocarbons ને ફેરવી બનતા chemicals છે.

સમજૂતી તથા ઉપયોગ

  • C1 methanol → formaldehyde/resins; C2 ethylene → VCM (PVC), EO (glycols).
  • C3 propylene → propylene oxide (polyurethanes); aromatics benzene → LAB (detergents).

h.en: Practice 2. Discuss petrochemical feedstocks: natural gas, naphtha/LPG, reformate and refinery gases, and what each principally yields.
h.gu: Practice 2. Petrochemical feedstocks ચર્ચો: natural gas, naphtha/LPG, reformate તથા refinery gases, અને દરેક મુખ્યત્વે શું આપે છે.

body.en:
Definition

A petrochemical feedstock is a hydrocarbon stream chemically converted instead of burned.

Explanation and application

  • Gas: methane to syngas/methanol; ethane to ethylene. Naphtha/LPG: steam cracking to olefins plus aromatics.
  • Reformate gives BTX and hydrogen; FCC gives propylene/butylenes — all at an opportunity cost against fuel use.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Petrochemical feedstock એ બાળવાને બદલે રાસાયણિક રીતે ફેરવાતો hydrocarbon stream છે.

સમજૂતી તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Gas: methane થી syngas/methanol; ethane થી ethylene. Naphtha/LPG: steam cracking થી olefins વત્તા aromatics.
  • Reformate BTX તથા hydrogen આપે છે; FCC propylene/butylenes આપે છે — બધું fuel ઉપયોગ સામે opportunity cost પર.

h.en: Practice 3. Describe the manufacture of methanol from syngas with a flow diagram, stating the reaction, catalyst and why gas is recycled.
h.gu: Practice 3. Flow diagram સાથે syngas માંથી methanol નું manufacture વર્ણવો, reaction, catalyst તથા gas કેમ recycle થાય છે તે જણાવો.

body.en:
Definition

CO + 2H2 ⇌ CH3OH over Cu/ZnO/Al2O3 in a recycle loop.

Explanation and application

  • Syngas preparation → converter (moderate T, elevated P) → condensation of methanol → recycle of unconverted gas with purge (diagram ref5_methanol).
  • Recycle exists because equilibrium limits each pass; distillation grades the crude methanol.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

CO + 2H2 ⇌ CH3OH recycle loop માં Cu/ZnO/Al2O3 પર.

સમજૂતી તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Syngas preparation → converter (moderate T, elevated P) → methanol નું condensation → purge સાથે unconverted gas નો recycle (diagram ref5_methanol).
  • Recycle એટલા માટે છે કે equilibrium દરેક pass ને મર્યાદિત કરે છે; distillation crude methanol ને grade કરે છે.

h.en: Practice 4. Explain the manufacture of formaldehyde from methanol, naming both catalyst systems and the product form sold.
h.gu: Practice 4. Methanol માંથી formaldehyde નું manufacture સમજાવો, બંને catalyst systems તથા વેચાતા product form નું નામ આપીને.

body.en:
Definition

Methanol vapour is oxidised with air to formaldehyde and absorbed into water as formalin.

Explanation and application

  • Silver catalyst (high temperature, with dehydrogenation) or Fe-Mo oxide (excess air, lower temperature).
  • Sold as aqueous formalin; reaction heat recovered as steam in the oxide process.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Methanol vapour air સાથે oxidise થઈ formaldehyde બને છે અને water માં formalin તરીકે શોષાય છે.

સમજૂતી તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Silver catalyst (ઊંચું temperature, dehydrogenation સાથે) કે Fe-Mo oxide (excess air, નીચું temperature).
  • Aqueous formalin તરીકે વેચાય છે; oxide process માં reaction heat steam તરીકે recover થાય છે.

h.en: Practice 5. With the three step reactions, explain the balanced process for vinyl chloride and show how the overall equation is obtained.
h.gu: Practice 5. ત્રણ step reactions સાથે, vinyl chloride માટે balanced process સમજાવો અને overall equation કેવી રીતે મળે છે તે બતાવો.

body.en:
Definition

Ethylene is half chlorinated and half oxychlorinated to EDC, which cracks to VCM + HCl.

Explanation and application

  • Steps: C2H4 + Cl2 → EDC; C2H4 + 2HCl + ½O2 → EDC + H2O; 2EDC → 2VCM + 2HCl.
  • Adding and cancelling EDC/HCl gives 2C2H4 + Cl2 + ½O2 → 2VCM + H2O (Numerical 5.N3).
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Ethylene અડધું chlorinate તથા અડધું oxychlorinate થઈ EDC બને છે, જે crack થઈ VCM + HCl આપે છે.

સમજૂતી તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Steps: C2H4 + Cl2 → EDC; C2H4 + 2HCl + ½O2 → EDC + H2O; 2EDC → 2VCM + 2HCl.
  • EDC/HCl ઉમેરી cancel કરતાં 2C2H4 + Cl2 + ½O2 → 2VCM + H2O મળે છે (Numerical 5.N3).

h.en: Practice 6. Describe ethylene oxide manufacture from ethylene: reaction, catalyst, absorption and the competing reaction.
h.gu: Practice 6. Ethylene માંથી ethylene oxide manufacture વર્ણવો: reaction, catalyst, absorption તથા competing reaction.

body.en:
Definition

Ethylene is directly oxidised over silver to ethylene oxide, absorbed in water and purified.

Explanation and application

  • Wanted: C2H4 + ½O2 → C2H4O; loss: C2H4 + 3O2 → 2CO2 + 2H2O.
  • Moderate per-pass conversion, ethylene recycle, inhibitor and composition control protect selectivity and safety.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Ethylene silver પર સીધું oxidise થઈ ethylene oxide બને છે, water માં શોષાઈ શુદ્ધ થાય છે.

સમજૂતી તથા ઉપયોગ

  • ઇચ્છિત: C2H4 + ½O2 → C2H4O; નુકસાન: C2H4 + 3O2 → 2CO2 + 2H2O.
  • Moderate per-pass conversion, ethylene recycle, inhibitor તથા composition control selectivity તથા safety ને બચાવે છે.

h.en: Practice 7. Compare the chlorohydrin, hydroperoxide and HPPO routes to propylene oxide on oxidant and co-product.
h.gu: Practice 7. Propylene oxide માટે chlorohydrin, hydroperoxide તથા HPPO routes ની oxidant તથા co-product પર સરખામણી કરો.

body.en:
Definition

All PO routes place one oxygen atom across propylene's double bond; they differ in the oxygen carrier.

Comparison

  • Chlorohydrin: chlorine/water then alkali; salt effluent. Hydroperoxide: styrene or tert-butanol co-product.
  • HPPO: hydrogen peroxide over titanium silicalite; water as the main by-product.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

બધા PO routes propylene ના double bond પર એક oxygen atom મૂકે છે; oxygen carrier માં જુદા પડે છે.

Comparison

  • Chlorohydrin: chlorine/water પછી alkali; salt effluent. Hydroperoxide: styrene કે tert-butanol co-product.
  • HPPO: titanium silicalite પર hydrogen peroxide; water મુખ્ય by-product તરીકે.

h.en: Practice 8. From 560 kg of CO, calculate theoretical and 85 %-yield methanol (CO + 2H2 → CH3OH; molar masses CO 28, CH3OH 32), showing every step.
h.gu: Practice 8. 560 kg CO માંથી, દરેક step બતાવી theoretical તથા 85 %-yield methanol ગણો (CO + 2H2 → CH3OH; molar masses CO 28, CH3OH 32).

body.en:
Given and assumptions

CO limiting, 560 kg; molar masses CO 28, CH3OH 32; η = 0.85.

Step-by-step solution

Theoretical = 560 × 32/28 = 640.0 kg; actual = 640.0 × 0.85 = 544.0 kg.

Interpretation and check

640 kg theoretical, 544 kg actual. Hydrogen uptake (80 kg) closes the mass account; full working in Numerical 5.N1.

આપેલ તથા ધારણાઓ

CO limiting, 560 kg; molar masses CO 28, CH3OH 32; η = 0.85.

Step-by-step solution

Theoretical = 560 × 32/28 = 640.0 kg; actual = 640.0 × 0.85 = 544.0 kg.

અર્થઘટન તથા check

640 kg theoretical, 544 kg actual. Hydrogen uptake (80 kg) mass account close કરે છે; સંપૂર્ણ working Numerical 5.N1 માં છે.

q.en: Numerical 5.N1: Methanol is synthesised by CO + 2H2 → CH3OH. Calculate the theoretical methanol from 560 kg of CO, and the actual production at 85 % fractional yield. (Molar masses: CO = 28, CH3OH = 32 kg/kmol.)
q.gu: Numerical 5.N1: Methanol CO + 2H2 → CH3OH થી synthesise થાય છે. 560 kg CO માંથી theoretical methanol ગણો, અને 85 % fractional yield પર actual production ગણો. (Molar masses: CO = 28, CH3OH = 32 kg/kmol.)

a.en:
Given

Reaction CO + 2H2 → CH3OH (1 kmol CO → 1 kmol CH3OH). CO charged = 560 kg, taken as the limiting reactant with hydrogen in excess. η = 0.85.

Find

Find theoretical methanol mass and actual methanol at 85 % yield.

Formula

nA = mA / MA
mP(theoretical) = mA × (νP·MP) / (νA·MA)
mP(actual) = mP(theoretical) × η

Substitution and calculation

nCO = 560 / 28 = 20.00 kmol
m(CH3OH, theoretical) = 560 × (1 × 32) / (1 × 28) = 640.0 kg
m(actual) = 640.0 × 0.85 = 544.0 kg

Final answer with units

Theoretical methanol = 640 kg; actual = 544 kg

Validity check

Product mass exceeds the CO mass because 2 × 2 = 4 kg of hydrogen joins each 28 kg of CO (20 kmol × 4 = 80 kg; 560 + 80 = 640 kg), so the answer conserves total mass exactly. The 15 % shortfall (96 kg of potential product) is the equilibrium/selectivity loss the recycle loop of card 5.2(a) works to recover.
a.gu:
આપેલ

Reaction CO + 2H2 → CH3OH (1 kmol CO → 1 kmol CH3OH). CO charged = 560 kg, hydrogen વધુ માત્રામાં સાથે limiting reactant તરીકે લીધું. η = 0.85.

શોધો

Theoretical methanol mass અને 85 % yield પર actual methanol શોધો.

સૂત્ર

nA = mA / MA
mP(theoretical) = mA × (νP·MP) / (νA·MA)
mP(actual) = mP(theoretical) × η

Substitution તથા Calculation

nCO = 560 / 28 = 20.00 kmol
m(CH3OH, theoretical) = 560 × (1 × 32) / (1 × 28) = 640.0 kg
m(actual) = 640.0 × 0.85 = 544.0 kg

Units સાથે અંતિમ જવાબ

Theoretical methanol = 640 kg; actual = 544 kg

Validity Check

Product mass CO mass કરતાં વધે છે કારણ કે દરેક 28 kg CO સાથે 2 × 2 = 4 kg hydrogen જોડાય છે (20 kmol × 4 = 80 kg; 560 + 80 = 640 kg), તેથી જવાબ કુલ mass ને બરાબર જાળવે છે. 15 % ની ખોટ (96 kg સંભવિત product) એ equilibrium/selectivity loss છે જેને card 5.2(a) નો recycle loop recover કરવા કામ કરે છે.

q.en: Numerical 5.N2: Formaldehyde is made by CH3OH + 1/2 O2 → HCHO + H2O. From 320 kg of methanol, calculate the theoretical formaldehyde and the methanol left unconverted if the actual formaldehyde obtained is 255 kg. (Molar masses: CH3OH = 32, HCHO = 30 kg/kmol.)
q.gu: Numerical 5.N2: Formaldehyde CH3OH + 1/2 O2 → HCHO + H2O થી બને છે. 320 kg methanol માંથી, theoretical formaldehyde ગણો અને જો મળતું actual formaldehyde 255 kg હોય તો unconverted રહેતું methanol ગણો. (Molar masses: CH3OH = 32, HCHO = 30 kg/kmol.)

a.en:
Given

Reaction 1 kmol CH3OH → 1 kmol HCHO. Methanol charged = 320 kg. Actual HCHO = 255 kg. (Fractional yield follows from the two masses.)

Find

Find theoretical HCHO, the implied yield, and methanol consumed and left.

Formula

mP(theoretical) = mA × (νP·MP) / (νA·MA)
Methanol consumed = HCHO formed × 32 / 30 (same mole ratio, inverted)

Substitution and calculation

n(CH3OH) = 320 / 32 = 10.00 kmol
Theoretical HCHO = 320 × 30 / 32 = 300.0 kg
Yield fraction = 255 / 300 = 0.850 (85.0 %)
Methanol consumed = 255 × 32 / 30 = 272.0 kg
Methanol unconverted = 320 − 272 = 48.0 kg

Final answer with units

Theoretical HCHO = 300 kg; actual yield = 85.0 %
Methanol consumed = 272 kg; unconverted = 48 kg

Validity check

Mass account: 272 kg methanol consumed gives 255 kg HCHO, the remaining 17 kg of consumed mass leaving as the water of reaction (272 + oxygen taken up − products closes on the reaction equation). The 48 kg unconverted methanol is what a real plant recovers and recycles — it is not a loss until purged.
a.gu:
આપેલ

Reaction 1 kmol CH3OH → 1 kmol HCHO. Methanol charged = 320 kg. Actual HCHO = 255 kg. (બે masses પરથી fractional yield મળે છે.)

શોધો

Theoretical HCHO, implied yield, અને વપરાયેલ તથા બચેલ methanol શોધો.

સૂત્ર

mP(theoretical) = mA × (νP·MP) / (νA·MA)
Methanol consumed = બનેલ HCHO × 32 / 30 (એ જ mole ratio, ઊલટું)

Substitution તથા Calculation

n(CH3OH) = 320 / 32 = 10.00 kmol
Theoretical HCHO = 320 × 30 / 32 = 300.0 kg
Yield fraction = 255 / 300 = 0.850 (85.0 %)
Methanol consumed = 255 × 32 / 30 = 272.0 kg
Methanol unconverted = 320 − 272 = 48.0 kg

Units સાથે અંતિમ જવાબ

Theoretical HCHO = 300 kg; actual yield = 85.0 %
Methanol consumed = 272 kg; unconverted = 48 kg

Validity Check

Mass account: 272 kg methanol વપરાઈ 255 kg HCHO આપે છે, વપરાયેલા mass ના બાકીના 17 kg reaction ના water તરીકે નીકળે છે (272 + લેવાયેલ oxygen − products reaction equation પર close થાય છે). 48 kg unconverted methanol એ છે જે વાસ્તવિક plant recover કરી recycle કરે છે — purge થાય ત્યાં સુધી તે loss નથી.

q.en: Numerical 5.N3: In the balanced VCM process, 2 mol of EDC crack to 2 mol VCM + 2 mol HCl, and the 2 mol HCl oxychlorinate 1 mol of fresh ethylene to 1 mol more EDC. Show that overall 2 mol ethylene + 1 mol Cl2 + 1/2 mol O2 give 2 mol VCM + 1 mol H2O, and calculate VCM from 56 kg of ethylene (molar mass 28; VCM = 62.5 kg/kmol).
q.gu: Numerical 5.N3: Balanced VCM process માં, 2 mol EDC crack થઈ 2 mol VCM + 2 mol HCl આપે છે, અને 2 mol HCl 1 mol fresh ethylene ને oxychlorinate કરી 1 mol વધુ EDC આપે છે. બતાવો કે overall 2 mol ethylene + 1 mol Cl2 + 1/2 mol O2 → 2 mol VCM + 1 mol H2O, અને 56 kg ethylene માંથી VCM ગણો (molar mass 28; VCM = 62.5 kg/kmol).

a.en:
Given

Step reactions as stated in card 5.3(a). Ethylene = 56 kg (2.000 kmol). Chlorine enters only in direct chlorination; HCl is fully recycled (balanced-process assumption).

Find

Derive the overall equation by adding the steps, then calculate theoretical VCM from 56 kg ethylene.

Formula

Add: chlorination C2H4 + Cl2 → EDC; oxychlorination C2H4 + 2 HCl + ½ O2 → EDC + H2O
Add: cracking 2 EDC → 2 VCM + 2 HCl; cancel EDC and HCl appearing on both sides
mP(theoretical) = mA × (νP·MP) / (νA·MA)

Substitution and calculation

Overall: 2 C2H4 + Cl2 + ½ O2 → 2 VCM + H2O (EDC and HCl cancel)
n(C2H4) = 56 / 28 = 2.000 kmol, giving n(VCM) = 2.000 kmol
m(VCM) = 2.000 × 62.5 = 125.0 kg

Final answer with units

Overall: 2 C2H4 + Cl2 + ½ O2 → 2 VCM + H2O
Theoretical VCM from 56 kg ethylene = 125 kg

Validity check

Atom check on the overall equation: C 4 = 4, H 8 = 8 (4 in 2 VCM... written fully: left H = 8; right 2 × 3 + 2 = 8), Cl 2 = 2, O 1 = 1 — balanced. Only 1 mol Cl2 serves 2 mol ethylene because the cracking HCl is reused: half the chlorine an unbalanced (direct-chlorination-only) route would need, which is the whole point of the balanced process.
a.gu:
આપેલ

Step reactions card 5.3(a) માં જણાવ્યા મુજબ. Ethylene = 56 kg (2.000 kmol). Chlorine ફક્ત direct chlorination માં પ્રવેશે છે; HCl સંપૂર્ણ recycle થાય છે (balanced-process ધારણા).

શોધો

Steps ઉમેરી overall equation મેળવો, પછી 56 kg ethylene માંથી theoretical VCM ગણો.

સૂત્ર

ઉમેરો: chlorination C2H4 + Cl2 → EDC; oxychlorination C2H4 + 2 HCl + ½ O2 → EDC + H2O
ઉમેરો: cracking 2 EDC → 2 VCM + 2 HCl; બંને બાજુ દેખાતા EDC તથા HCl cancel કરો
mP(theoretical) = mA × (νP·MP) / (νA·MA)

Substitution તથા Calculation

Overall: 2 C2H4 + Cl2 + ½ O2 → 2 VCM + H2O (EDC તથા HCl cancel)
n(C2H4) = 56 / 28 = 2.000 kmol, જેથી n(VCM) = 2.000 kmol
m(VCM) = 2.000 × 62.5 = 125.0 kg

Units સાથે અંતિમ જવાબ

Overall: 2 C2H4 + Cl2 + ½ O2 → 2 VCM + H2O
56 kg ethylene માંથી theoretical VCM = 125 kg

Validity Check

Overall equation પર atom check: C 4 = 4, H 8 = 8 (સંપૂર્ણ લખતાં: ડાબે H = 8; જમણે 2 × 3 + 2 = 8), Cl 2 = 2, O 1 = 1 — balanced. ફક્ત 1 mol Cl2 2 mol ethylene ને સેવા આપે છે કારણ કે cracking HCl ફરી વપરાય છે: unbalanced (ફક્ત direct-chlorination) route ને જોઈતા chlorine નું અડધું, જે balanced process નો આખો મુદ્દો છે.

terms.en: A is the limiting reactant; coefficients and molar masses come from the balanced equation only.
terms.gu: A એ limiting reactant છે; coefficients તથા molar masses ફક્ત balanced equation માંથી આવે છે.

terms.en: η folds in equilibrium limits, selectivity loss and separation recovery; state which applies.
terms.gu: η માં equilibrium limits, selectivity loss તથા separation recovery સમાય છે; કયું લાગુ પડે છે તે જણાવો.

items.f: Add step equations; cancel species appearing on both sides (EDC, HCl in VCM).

terms.en: Species that cancel are recycled intermediates, not consumed raw materials — the key to balanced-process economics.
terms.gu: Cancel થતી species recycled intermediates છે, વપરાતા raw materials નહીં — balanced-process economics ની ચાવી.

items.f: Fresh feed = feed to reactor − recycled unconverted feed (at steady state, purge takes out inerts).

terms.en: Applied in methanol, EO and LAB loops; unconverted feed is recovered, not lost, until purged.
terms.gu: Methanol, EO તથા LAB loops માં લાગુ; unconverted feed purge થાય ત્યાં સુધી recovered છે, lost નથી.

q.en: Define petrochemicals in one line.
q.gu: Petrochemicals ને એક line માં વ્યાખ્યાયિત કરો.

a.en: Chemicals manufactured from petroleum or natural-gas feedstocks by chemical conversion of their hydrocarbons.
a.gu: Petroleum કે natural-gas feedstocks માંથી તેમના hydrocarbons ના રાસાયણિક conversion દ્વારા બનતા chemicals.

q.en: Name the four feedstock families of this unit and one building block from each.
q.gu: આ unit ના ચાર feedstock families તથા દરેકમાંથી એક building block જણાવો.

a.en: C1: methanol from syngas; C2: ethylene to VCM/EO; C3: propylene to propylene oxide; aromatics: benzene to LAB (any correct set).
a.gu: C1: syngas માંથી methanol; C2: ethylene થી VCM/EO; C3: propylene થી propylene oxide; aromatics: benzene થી LAB (કોઈપણ સાચો set).

q.en: Which refinery units supply petrochemical feedstocks?
q.gu: કયા refinery units petrochemical feedstocks પૂરા પાડે છે?

a.en: Steam crackers (naphtha/LPG), catalytic reformer (BTX and hydrogen), FCC (propylene/butylenes) and gas plants (methane/ethane for syngas and ethylene).
a.gu: Steam crackers (naphtha/LPG), catalytic reformer (BTX તથા hydrogen), FCC (propylene/butylenes) અને gas plants (syngas તથા ethylene માટે methane/ethane).

q.en: Write the methanol synthesis reaction and name the catalyst family.
q.gu: Methanol synthesis reaction લખો અને catalyst family નું નામ આપો.

a.en: CO + 2H2 ⇌ CH3OH over a copper-based (Cu/ZnO/Al2O3) catalyst, with unconverted gas recycled because the reaction is equilibrium-limited.
a.gu: CO + 2H2 ⇌ CH3OH copper-based (Cu/ZnO/Al2O3) catalyst પર, reaction equilibrium-limited હોવાથી unconverted gas recycle સાથે.

q.en: How is formaldehyde obtained from methanol?
q.gu: Methanol માંથી formaldehyde કેવી રીતે મળે છે?

a.en: By catalytic oxidation/dehydrogenation of methanol vapour with air over silver or iron–molybdenum oxide catalyst, then absorption in water to formalin.
a.gu: Methanol vapour ને silver કે iron–molybdenum oxide catalyst પર air સાથે catalytic oxidation/dehydrogenation કરી, પછી water માં શોષી formalin તરીકે.

q.en: Why is the VCM process called balanced?
q.gu: VCM process ને balanced કેમ કહે છે?

a.en: Because the HCl released by EDC cracking exactly oxychlorinates the second half of the ethylene, so chlorine is consumed for only half the feed and no HCl is wasted.
a.gu: કારણ કે EDC cracking થી છૂટતું HCl બરાબર ethylene ના બીજા અડધા ભાગનું oxychlorination કરે છે, જેથી chlorine ફક્ત અડધા feed માટે વપરાય છે અને કોઈ HCl બગડતું નથી.

q.en: What competes with ethylene oxide formation and how is it limited?
q.gu: Ethylene oxide formation સાથે શું સ્પર્ધા કરે છે અને તે કેવી રીતે મર્યાદિત થાય છે?

a.en: Total combustion of ethylene to CO2 and water; it is limited by the silver catalyst's selectivity, trace inhibitor and keeping per-pass conversion moderate.
a.gu: Ethylene નું CO2 તથા water સુધી total combustion; તે silver catalyst ની selectivity, trace inhibitor તથા per-pass conversion moderate રાખવાથી મર્યાદિત થાય છે.

q.en: Name two propylene oxide routes and their co-products.
q.gu: બે propylene oxide routes તથા તેમના co-products જણાવો.

a.en: Hydroperoxide routes give styrene (PO/SM) or tert-butanol (PO/TBA) as co-products; HPPO gives mainly water; the classic chlorohydrin route gives salt effluent instead.
a.gu: Hydroperoxide routes co-products તરીકે styrene (PO/SM) કે tert-butanol (PO/TBA) આપે છે; HPPO મુખ્યત્વે water આપે છે; classic chlorohydrin route તેના બદલે salt effluent આપે છે.

q.en: Why is LAB called linear and why does it matter?
q.gu: LAB ને linear કેમ કહે છે અને તે કેમ મહત્વનું છે?

a.en: Its alkyl chain is straight (C10–C14), and linear alkylates biodegrade readily, unlike the branched alkylbenzene sulfonates they replaced.
a.gu: તેની alkyl chain સીધી (C10–C14) છે, અને linear alkylates સહેલાઈથી biodegrade થાય છે, તેમણે બદલેલા branched alkylbenzene sulfonates થી વિપરીત.

q.en: What is LAB used for after sulfonation?
q.gu: Sulfonation પછી LAB શેના માટે વપરાય છે?

a.en: As the surfactant (LAS) active matter of synthetic detergents and cleaning products.
a.gu: Synthetic detergents તથા cleaning products ના surfactant (LAS) active matter તરીકે.

q.en: Distinguish theoretical and actual yield.
q.gu: Theoretical તથા actual yield વચ્ચે તફાવત કરો.

a.en: Theoretical yield is the stoichiometric ceiling from the limiting reactant; actual yield is that ceiling multiplied by the plant fraction η after equilibrium, selectivity and separation losses.
a.gu: Theoretical yield એ limiting reactant પરથી stoichiometric ceiling છે; actual yield એ equilibrium, selectivity તથા separation losses પછી તે ceiling ને plant fraction η થી ગુણેલું છે.

q.en: Why does a methanol plant recycle most of its reactor gas?
q.gu: Methanol plant તેના reactor gas નો મોટો ભાગ કેમ recycle કરે છે?

a.en: Because equilibrium limits conversion per pass; recycling passes the unconverted CO/H2 over the catalyst again, with a small purge to reject accumulated inerts.
a.gu: કારણ કે equilibrium pass દીઠ conversion મર્યાદિત કરે છે; recycling unconverted CO/H2 ને ફરી catalyst પર પસાર કરે છે, જમા થયેલા inerts નકારવા નાના purge સાથે.

q.en: Practice: Define petrochemicals and classify them with one building block and one end product for each family.
q.gu: Practice: Petrochemicals ની વ્યાખ્યા આપો અને દરેક family માટે એક building block તથા એક end product સાથે classification કરો.

q.en: Practice: Discuss petrochemical feedstocks: natural gas, naphtha/LPG, reformate and refinery gases, and what each principally yields.
q.gu: Practice: Petrochemical feedstocks ચર્ચો: natural gas, naphtha/LPG, reformate તથા refinery gases, અને દરેક મુખ્યત્વે શું આપે છે.

q.en: Practice: Describe the manufacture of methanol from syngas with a flow diagram, stating the reaction, catalyst and why gas is recycled.
q.gu: Practice: Flow diagram સાથે syngas માંથી methanol નું manufacture વર્ણવો, reaction, catalyst તથા gas કેમ recycle થાય છે તે જણાવો.

q.en: Practice: Explain the manufacture of formaldehyde from methanol, naming both catalyst systems and the product form sold.
q.gu: Practice: Methanol માંથી formaldehyde નું manufacture સમજાવો, બંને catalyst systems તથા વેચાતા product form નું નામ આપીને.

q.en: Practice: With the three step reactions, explain the balanced process for vinyl chloride and show how the overall equation is obtained.
q.gu: Practice: ત્રણ step reactions સાથે, vinyl chloride માટે balanced process સમજાવો અને overall equation કેવી રીતે મળે છે તે બતાવો.

q.en: Practice: Describe ethylene oxide manufacture from ethylene: reaction, catalyst, absorption and the competing reaction.
q.gu: Practice: Ethylene માંથી ethylene oxide manufacture વર્ણવો: reaction, catalyst, absorption તથા competing reaction.

q.en: Practice: Compare the chlorohydrin, hydroperoxide and HPPO routes to propylene oxide on oxidant and co-product.
q.gu: Practice: Propylene oxide માટે chlorohydrin, hydroperoxide તથા HPPO routes ની oxidant તથા co-product પર સરખામણી કરો.

q.en: Practice: From 560 kg of CO, calculate theoretical and 85 %-yield methanol (CO + 2H2 → CH3OH; molar masses CO 28, CH3OH 32), showing every step.
q.gu: Practice: 560 kg CO માંથી, દરેક step બતાવી theoretical તથા 85 %-yield methanol ગણો (CO + 2H2 → CH3OH; molar masses CO 28, CH3OH 32).

body.en:
Aim and apparatus

Aim: to chart (i) petrochemical feedstocks from refinery/gas streams and (ii) one process from this unit (methanol, formaldehyde, VCM, EO, PO or LAB) at block-flow level. Materials: unit cards and diagrams, chart sheets.

Qualified-supervised procedure

  1. Draw the feedstock tree: gas, naphtha/LPG and reformate/FCC streams to their building blocks (diagram ref5_feedstocks pattern).
  2. For the chosen process, show feed preparation, reactor, separation/recycle and product, with the Unit 5 reaction written above the reactor block.
  3. Mark every recycle (unconverted feed, HCl in VCM, benzene in LAB) and state in one line why it exists.

Precautions

Charts must not invent operating data: conditions are quoted only as the typical ranges the cards state, and no plant visit or plant data is claimed unless the institute arranged and recorded it separately.

Observations and result

Journal record: feedstock tree complete ___, process charted ___, recycles identified ___, reaction shown ___. Chart activity only.
body.gu:
Aim and apparatus

Aim: (i) refinery/gas streams માંથી petrochemical feedstocks અને (ii) આ unit નો એક process (methanol, formaldehyde, VCM, EO, PO કે LAB) block-flow level પર chart કરવો. Materials: unit cards તથા diagrams, chart sheets.

Qualified-supervised procedure

  1. Feedstock tree દોરો: gas, naphtha/LPG તથા reformate/FCC streams તેમના building blocks તરફ (diagram ref5_feedstocks pattern).
  2. પસંદ કરેલા process માટે, feed preparation, reactor, separation/recycle તથા product બતાવો, reactor block ઉપર Unit 5 reaction લખીને.
  3. દરેક recycle (unconverted feed, VCM માં HCl, LAB માં benzene) mark કરો અને એક line માં તે કેમ છે તે જણાવો.

Precautions

Charts એ operating data ઉપજાવવા નહીં: conditions ફક્ત cards જણાવે છે તે typical ranges તરીકે જ ટાંકવામાં આવે છે, અને સંસ્થાએ અલગથી ગોઠવી નોંધ્યું હોય તે સિવાય કોઈ plant visit કે plant data નો દાવો નથી.
